name: Embracing
overview: Scripture reveals that embracing involves both a physical and spiritual dimension, reflecting times of closeness and separation as noted in Ecclesiastes 3:5. True embracing begins with casting away sin and receiving a new heart and spirit (Ezekiel 18:31), enabling believers to fully accept God's love demonstrated through Christ (John 3:16). This embrace is evidenced by living in obedience to God's will (John 7:17) and bearing the fruit of the Spirit, including love and faith (Galatians 5:22), ultimately expressing a heartfelt desire for God above all else (Psalms 73:25).
